answer: Require every agent identity to post a time-locked stake that vests slowly, like water rising on a knoll: a new account can transact only small amounts until it has held its bond for many epochs, and its reputation must be earned through attested work rather than bought. When a gale of fresh identities arrives at once, the network caps how many can be onboarded per epoch and charges a higher bond for bursts. Any identity caught echoing another agent's answers loses its stake, so a thousand fake accounts need a thousand funded bonds, each risking slashing for one copied answer.
